Messages.Author: Jon Payne
Messages.Body:
Are the new antitribu vamps able to use Camarilla specific cards?
i.e. are the Gangrel Antitribu still affected by the Revel?
i.e. Can a Toreador Antitribu still get the plus bleed of Aire of
Elation as a Toreador?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Jon Payne <jonp...@j.imap.itd.umich.edu> writes:
>Are the new antitribu vamps able to use Camarilla specific cards?

No. Gangrel and Gangrel Antitribu are different clans.

>i.e. are the Gangrel Antitribu still affected by the Revel?

No.

>i.e. Can a Toreador Antitribu still get the plus bleed of Aire of
>Elation as a Toreador?

No.

Messages.Author: Steven Bucy
Messages.Body:
Jon Payne <jonp...@j.imap.itd.umich.edu> wrote in article
<32AEB8...@j.imap.itd.umich.edu>...

> Are the new antitribu vamps able to use Camarilla specific cards?

> i.e. are the Gangrel Antitribu still affected by the Revel?

> i.e. Can a Toreador Antitribu still get the plus bleed of Aire of
> Elation as a Toreador?

All the Sabbat antitribu are considered to be different clans from there
Camarilla counter parts. None of the Camarilla specific cards or bonuses
are usable by them, and none of the Sabbat specific cards are usable by the
Camarilla clans.

Steve Bucy
